judge.rationale: The candidate's implementation is functionally sound and accurately sums token counts across rounds while preserving `undefined` when no usage is reported. However, it slightly violates the acceptance criterion that the existing no-tool test remain unedited by modifying the type annotation in `receives collected response text and usage` (and in `toolBudget.test.ts`), and it records the new behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` rather than promoting it to the main spec list. Compared to the reference, which simply renamed the hook parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and added tests to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate introduces a separate `AggregateUsage` interface in `src/types/ai.ts` and splits tests across two new test files plus `.lore/dod.md`.
